live.instructions: When this is the start of a new conversation and the user has not yet said what they want to build, welcome them as someone who is now connected to Clipform and offer to build their first form together, then offer these starting points as plain text: lead-gen, feedback, quiz, or something else - ask which one fits, or invite them to describe what they need instead. If the user's first message already states what they want to build, even loosely, skip that offer entirely and go straight into the brief-driven flow below. Clipform builds interactive video-style forms. When the brief is clear, build the form directly; when it's vague, ask one or two short questions first. Before building, derive a register from the topic and audience (e.g. hype, playful, warm, considered, elegant, sombre); if the user states a mood explicitly, that wins. State the register once, then apply it to every question, option, and end-screen line. Never mix registers in one form. At the start of a build, call clipform_get_workflow to load the recipe for the form type, and clipform_get_guide for craft detail. Every *_id argument is a UUID returned by the tools - not the short share_id from a form URL. For an account-scoped request, call clipform_whoami first to confirm the active workspace and plan. Deleting a form moves it to the trash (restorable from the dashboard); deleting a node is permanent. Those tools ask the user to confirm before running.

tools.name: clipform_set_logic
tools.title: Set Node Logic
tools.description:
Set the next node for one or more nodes, wiring a linear route (A to B to C). Pass multiple nodes in one call instead of separate tool calls. Each node routes to exactly one target node. Branching by which option a respondent picks is not configured here; it is set up in the form's Build tab in the dashboard (the builder URL returned by clipform_get_form / clipform_create_form).

A call replaces that node's routing entirely - it does not merge with any prior target.

Example:
  nodes: [
    { node_id: "q1-id", rules: [{ target_node_id: "q2-id" }] },
    { node_id: "q2-id", rules: [{ target_node_id: "q3-id" }] }
  ]

tools.name: clipform_get_form
tools.title: Get Clipform
tools.description: Retrieve a form's details including all nodes in sequential order and their routing. Returns title, settings, and every node with its options, config, media status, and next node (from clipform_set_logic).

form_id.description: The form UUID (returned by clipform_create_form, not the short share_id from the URL)

context.description: Describe the user's underlying goal in one sentence - not the tool you're calling.

form_id.description: Form UUID

has_unpublished_changes.description: Live form has edits not yet republished

urls.description: Dashboard/viewer deeplinks for this form. An anonymous caller gets only 'viewer'.

viewer.description: Live respondent link, or - for an anonymous caller's draft - a private preview link where answers are not saved (do not share it with respondents). Omitted for a non-anonymous caller's unpublished draft.

builder.description: Build tab - the node/canvas editor. Not present for an anonymous caller.

summary.description: Summary tab - form overview and key stats. Not present for an anonymous caller.

responses.description: Responses tab - individual submissions. Not present for an anonymous caller.

analytics.description: Analytics tab - views, starts, completion rate, drop-off per node. Not present for an anonymous caller.

share.description: Share tab - link, QR, social. Not present for an anonymous caller.

embed.description: Embed setup for websites. Not present for an anonymous caller.

dynamic_link.description: Dynamic/personalized link setup. Not present for an anonymous caller.

next.description: This node's outgoing edge, set via clipform_set_logic. Omitted for a chain tail or terminal node.

target_id.description: The node/screen ID this node routes to

target_type.description: What kind of target target_id is

nodes.description: Nodes in sequential order - IDs for update_node / attach_node_media

tools.name: clipform_update_form
tools.title: Update Clipform
tools.description: Update a form's title, publish status, settings, or tags. Only sends fields that are provided - omitted fields remain unchanged. AI-PROTECTED parameters have restrictions noted in their descriptions.

form_id.description: The form UUID (returned by clipform_create_form, not the short share_id from the URL)

is_live.description: Setting true publishes/republishes the snapshot respondents see. Forms are live from creation, but edits and media attached AFTER creation are not visible until you re-send true - republishing is the expected final step of a build, never skip it after attaching media. Setting false takes the form offline (keeps the last published snapshot) - AI-PROTECTED: only take a form offline when the user explicitly asks.

show_step_counter.description: Show step counter (e.g. '1/5'). Recommended for quizzes.

disable_back_navigation.description: Prevent respondents from going back. Recommended for quizzes.

total_steps.description: Override the total step count shown in the step counter. Set null to auto-calculate.

primary_color.description: Primary/brand color as 6-digit hex (e.g. '#FF5500'). Used for buttons and accents.

font_family.description: AI-PROTECTED: Only set when the user explicitly requests a specific font.

description.description: SEO description (meta description, og:description). Set null to clear.

author.description: AI-PROTECTED: Only set when the user explicitly provides an author name. Set null to clear.

logo_url.description: AI-PROTECTED: Only set when the user explicitly provides a logo URL. Set null to clear.

show_branding.description: Show Clipform branding. Set false to remove (Pro plan).

brand_name.description: AI-PROTECTED: Custom brand name shown in footer. Only set when user explicitly provides.

tags.description: Replace all tags on this form. Pass the full desired set (e.g. ['quiz', 'trivia', 'slug:elephants']). Omit to leave tags unchanged.

context.description: Describe the user's underlying goal in one sentence - not the tool you're calling.

form_id.description: Form UUID

updated_fields.description: Names of the fields that were changed by this call

tools.name: clipform_delete_form
tools.title: Delete Clipform
tools.description: Move a form and all its nodes to the trash. It stops accepting responses immediately and can be restored later. Requires user confirmation before it runs. Needs a signed-in Clipform account (an anonymous session is asked to sign in).

form_id.description: The form UUID to delete (returned by clipform_create_form, not the short share_id from the URL)

confirm.description: Set to true ONLY after the user has explicitly confirmed this destructive action. Leave unset otherwise - hosts that support confirmation dialogs will prompt the user automatically.

context.description: Describe the user's underlying goal in one sentence - not the tool you're calling.

tools.name: clipform_get_results
tools.title: Get Clipform Results
tools.description: View response counts, choice/action answer breakdowns, and recent open-text answers for a form. Contact, file, draw, camera, and payment answers are counts only - use the dashboard for per-response detail. Needs a signed-in Clipform account (an anonymous session is asked to sign in).

form_id.description: The form UUID (returned by clipform_create_form, not the short share_id from the URL)

context.description: Describe the user's underlying goal in one sentence - not the tool you're calling.

total_responses.description: Total unique respondents to the form

options.description: Answer breakdown - choice and action-category (booking/file_download/shopping) nodes only

recent_answers.description: Most recent open-text answers, capped at 20 - open questions only

nodes.description: Nodes in form order. Contact/file/draw/camera/payment nodes carry only total_responses/total_views - no per-response detail.

results_url.description: Dashboard Responses tab for this form. Not present for an anonymous caller.

tools.name: clipform_get_responses
tools.title: List form responses
tools.description: List a Clipform form's individual responses (submissions) with time filtering - complements clipform_get_results (aggregates). Answers questions like 'what came in during the last 24 hours', 'what's the longest answer', 'what did people say'. Text answers plus a non-PII payment summary (amount and status); contact details, file uploads, and audio/video answers are redacted to placeholders and the customer's payment details stay in the dashboard (the responses URL from clipform_get_form). Responses are sorted newest first unless sort: 'oldest'. Needs a signed-in Clipform account (an anonymous session is asked to sign in).

form_id.description: Form UUID (from clipform_list_forms / clipform_create_form)

since.description: Only responses submitted at or after this ISO 8601 time (e.g. '2026-08-29T00:00:00Z')

until.description: Only responses submitted at or before this ISO 8601 time

query.description: Only responses whose text answers contain this string (case-insensitive)

sort.description: Order by submission time. Default: newest

context.description: Describe the user's underlying goal in one sentence - not the tool you're calling.

total_matching.description: Responses matching the filters (before the limit cap)

locked_over_plan_limit.description: Matching responses hidden by the plan's response limit

answer.description: Text answer, or a redaction placeholder

responses.description: Matching responses, filtered/sorted/capped per the inputs

tools.name: clipform_add_node
tools.title: Add Node
tools.description: Add a new node to an existing form. Inserted before the end screen by default; after_node_id controls insertion position. Inserting into a linear flow automatically re-links the chain (the node before the insertion point points to the new node, which points to what followed) - you do not need clipform_set_logic for a simple insert. Branching still needs an explicit logic write. Node types and config schemas match clipform_create_form.

form_id.description: The form UUID (returned by clipform_create_form, not the short share_id from the URL)

prompt.description: The text shown to the respondent

label.description: Short label for the node (used in logic builder). Defaults to the prompt text.

config.description: Type-specific configuration keyed by node type. Omit to use defaults. Per-type keys, shapes, and defaults are listed in the clipform_create_form description; craft guidance via clipform_get_guide.

options.description: Answer options. choice: required, min 1, max 6, content max 36 chars button: required, min 1, max 1, content max 28 chars

is_correct.description: Mark this as the correct answer for a quiz (maps to score 1; other options score 0). Use this OR score, not both.

score.description: Score value for this option (for scored quizzes). Use 1 for correct, 0 for wrong. Scored options automatically enable correct-answer marking (record_scores) and correct/incorrect answer feedback on the node; set config.choice.show_answer_feedback: false to hide the feedback.

after_node_id.description: Insert after this node ID. Omit to append before the end screen.

context.description: Describe the user's underlying goal in one sentence - not the tool you're calling.

node_id.description: ID of the created node - pass to update_node / attach_node_media

tools.name: clipform_update_node
tools.title: Update Node
tools.description: Update one or more existing nodes' text, type, config, or options. Pass multiple updates in one call instead of separate tool calls. Requires node IDs (returned by clipform_create_form, clipform_add_node, or clipform_get_form). Does not change node positions in the flow. All type definitions and config schemas are derived from @vid-master/config (node-types).

form_id.description: The form UUID (returned by clipform_create_form, not the short share_id from the URL)

label.description: Short label for the node (used in logic builder)

config.description: Type-specific configuration keyed by node type. Omit to use defaults. Per-type keys, shapes, and defaults are listed in the clipform_create_form description; craft guidance via clipform_get_guide. Merged shallowly into the stored config - only the keys you pass are changed. Set a key to null to delete it; nested objects are replaced wholesale. When type is changed in the same call, config replaces the stored configuration instead of merging.

options.description: Replace all options (for choice nodes). Omit to keep existing options.

is_correct.description: Mark this as the correct answer for a quiz (maps to score 1; other options score 0). Use this OR score, not both.

score.description: Score value for this option (for scored quizzes). Use 1 for correct, 0 for wrong. Scored options automatically enable correct-answer marking (record_scores) and correct/incorrect answer feedback on the node; set config.choice.show_answer_feedback: false to hide the feedback.

updates.description: One or more node updates to apply

context.description: Describe the user's underlying goal in one sentence - not the tool you're calling.

results.description: One result per requested update, in order

tools.name: clipform_delete_node
tools.title: Delete Node
tools.description: Delete a node from a form. The logic chain is automatically re-linked (the previous node will point to the next one). Cannot delete the start node or the last end screen. Requires user confirmation before it runs.

form_id.description: The form UUID (returned by clipform_create_form, not the short share_id from the URL)

confirm.description: Set to true ONLY after the user has explicitly confirmed this destructive action. Leave unset otherwise - hosts that support confirmation dialogs will prompt the user automatically.

context.description: Describe the user's underlying goal in one sentence - not the tool you're calling.

tools.name: clipform_set_logic
tools.title: Set Node Logic
tools.description:
Set the next node for one or more nodes, wiring a linear route (A to B to C). Pass multiple nodes in one call instead of separate tool calls. Each node routes to exactly one target node. Branching by which option a respondent picks is not configured here; it is set up in the form's Build tab in the dashboard (the builder URL returned by clipform_get_form / clipform_create_form).

A call replaces that node's routing entirely - it does not merge with any prior target.

Example:
  nodes: [
    { node_id: "q1-id", rules: [{ target_node_id: "q2-id" }] },
    { node_id: "q2-id", rules: [{ target_node_id: "q3-id" }] }
  ]

form_id.description: The form UUID (returned by clipform_create_form, not the short share_id from the URL)

node_id.description: The node ID to set routing on

target_node_id.description: The node ID this node routes to

rules.description: Exactly one rule: the single node this node routes to

nodes.description: One or more nodes to set logic on

context.description: Describe the user's underlying goal in one sentence - not the tool you're calling.

results.description: One result per node, in order

tools.name: clipform_get_guide
tools.title: Get Craft Guide
tools.description:
Retrieve craft knowledge for building a specific form type. Returns question psychology, difficulty curves, narration style, scoring setup, and writing principles as markdown. Does NOT return a step-by-step build workflow - use clipform_get_workflow for that.

Available types: quiz, survey, interview, funnel, testimonial, application, booking, intake, lead-capture.
Aliases also accepted: trivia → quiz, test → quiz, exam → quiz, feedback → survey, poll → survey, nps → survey, questionnaire → survey, case-study → interview, callout → interview, lead-gen → funnel, qualification → funnel, lead-magnet → funnel, story → testimonial, review → testimonial, job-application → application, admission → application, enrollment → application, grant → application, registration → booking, signup → booking, event → booking, rsvp → booking, workshop → booking, client-intake → intake, onboarding → intake, enquiry → intake, inquiry → intake, new-client → intake, lead → lead-capture, lead-form → lead-capture, enquiry-form → lead-capture, waitlist → lead-capture, get-a-quote → lead-capture.
Quiz variants (optional): personality, comprehension, composition - appends variant-specific addendum to the base quiz guide.

type.description: Form type to get the craft guide for (accepts aliases like 'feedback' → survey)

variant.description: Quiz sub-variant. Only used when type is 'quiz'. Omit for a standard scored quiz.

context.description: Describe the user's underlying goal in one sentence - not the tool you're calling.

tools.name: clipform_get_workflow
tools.title: Get Build Workflow
tools.description:
Retrieve a step-by-step build workflow for creating a specific form type. Returns the exact tool sequence, form settings, node configuration, scoring setup, and end screen config as a build recipe.

Does NOT return craft knowledge (question psychology, difficulty curves, narration style) - use clipform_get_guide for that.

Available types: quiz, survey, interview, testimonial, application, booking, intake, lead-capture.
Aliases also accepted: trivia → quiz, test → quiz, exam → quiz, feedback → survey, poll → survey, nps → survey, questionnaire → survey, case-study → interview, callout → interview, lead-gen → funnel, qualification → funnel, lead-magnet → funnel, story → testimonial, review → testimonial, job-application → application, admission → application, enrollment → application, grant → application, registration → booking, signup → booking, event → booking, rsvp → booking, workshop → booking, client-intake → intake, onboarding → intake, enquiry → intake, inquiry → intake, new-client → intake, lead → lead-capture, lead-form → lead-capture, enquiry-form → lead-capture, waitlist → lead-capture, get-a-quote → lead-capture.
Quiz variants (optional): personality, comprehension, composition - returns the variant-specific workflow instead of the base quiz workflow.

Optional args by type:
- quiz: topic, question_count (8)
- quiz (variant: personality): topic, categories, question_count (8)
- quiz (variant: comprehension): question_count (8), audience
- interview: purpose, response_format (all), needs_consent (true)
- survey: topic, anonymous (true)
- funnel: outcomes, criteria, needs_contact (true)
- testimonial: use_case
- application: role
- booking: event_name, event_type
- intake: use_case, response_format (all)
- lead-capture: use_case

type.description: Form type to get the build workflow for (accepts aliases like 'feedback' → survey)

variant.description: Quiz sub-variant. Only used when type is 'quiz'. Omit for a standard scored quiz.
